question: Which team won the ICC Men's t20 World Cup 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**India**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India** won the **ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2024** by defeating **South Africa** in the final.
 
• The final was played on **29 June 2024** at the **Kensington Oval, Bridgetown, Barbados**.
 
• India scored **176/7** in 20 overs, while South Africa finished at **169/8**, giving India a **7-run victory**.
 
• This was **India's second ICC Men's T20 World Cup title**, the first being won in **2007** under the captaincy of **MS Dhoni**.
 
• **Rohit Sharma** captained the Indian team, while **Jasprit Bumrah** was named the **Player of the Tournament** for his outstanding bowling performance.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1 – India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Host Countries:** West Indies and the United States.
 
• **Player of the Tournament:** **Jasprit Bumrah (India)**.
 
• **Player of the Match (Final):** **Virat Kohli (India)**, who scored **76 runs**.
 
• **Winning Captain:** **Rohit Sharma**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Winner:** **India**.
 
• **Runner-up:** **South Africa**.
 
• **Final Venue:** **Kensington Oval, Bridgetown, Barbados**.
 
• **Result:** India won by **7 runs**.
 
• **India's T20 World Cup Titles:** **2007** and **2024 (till 2024)**
